spec.description: Health, utilization and stopped services of all Windows hosts monitored by windows_exporter.

spec.expr: max by (instance, hostname) (windows_os_hostname{job=~"$job", hostname=~"$hostname"})
(max by (instance, product, version) (windows_os_info{job=~"$job"})) and on (instance) windows_os_hostname{job=~"$job", hostname=~"$hostname"}
(max by (instance) (time() - windows_system_boot_time_timestamp{job=~"$job"})) and on (instance) windows_os_hostname{job=~"$job", hostname=~"$hostname"}
(max by (instance) (windows_cpu_logical_processor{job=~"$job"})) and on (instance) windows_os_hostname{job=~"$job", hostname=~"$hostname"}
(100 * (1 - avg by (instance) (clamp_max(rate(windows_cpu_time_total{job=~"$job", mode="idle"}[$__rate_interval]), 1)))) and on (instance) windows_os_hostname{job=~"$job", hostname=~"$hostname"}
(max by (instance) (windows_memory_physical_total_bytes{job=~"$job"})) and on (instance) windows_os_hostname{job=~"$job", hostname=~"$hostname"}

(max by (instance) (100 * (1 - windows_memory_physical_free_bytes{job=~"$job"} / windows_memory_physical_total_bytes{job=~"$job"}))) and on (instance) windows_os_hostname{job=~"$job", hostname=~"$hostname"}
(max by (instance) (100 * windows_memory_committed_bytes{job=~"$job"} / windows_memory_commit_limit_bytes{job=~"$job"})) and on (instance) windows_os_hostname{job=~"$job", hostname=~"$hostname"}

(max by (instance) (100 * (1 - windows_logical_disk_free_bytes{job=~"$job", volume!~"HarddiskVolume.*"} / windows_logical_disk_size_bytes{job=~"$job", volume!~"HarddiskVolume.*"}))) and on (instance) windows_os_hostname{job=~"$job", hostname=~"$hostname"}
(sum by (instance) (windows_service_state{job=~"$job", state="running"})) and on (instance) windows_os_hostname{job=~"$job", hostname=~"$hostname"}

(count by (instance) (windows_service_state{job=~"$job", state="running"} == 0 and on (instance, service) windows_service_start_mode{job=~"$job", start_mode="auto"} == 1)) and on (instance) windows_os_hostname{job=~"$job", hostname=~"$hostname"}
(max by (instance) (windows_system_processes{job=~"$job"})) and on (instance) windows_os_hostname{job=~"$job", hostname=~"$hostname"}

(max by (instance) (100 * (1 - windows_logical_disk_free_bytes{job=~"$job", volume="C:"} / windows_logical_disk_size_bytes{job=~"$job", volume="C:"}))) and on (instance) windows_os_hostname{job=~"$job", hostname=~"$hostname"}

spec.description: One row per scraped host. Click a hostname to open its details. C: used is the usage of the C: volume, usually the system drive; Fullest volume is the most used volume with a drive letter. Services up counts running services; Auto stopped counts services with start mode auto that are not running.
spec.title: Hosts

spec.expr: count(windows_os_hostname{job=~"$job", hostname=~"$hostname"})

spec.description: Hosts that match the Job and Hostname selection and report windows_os_hostname.
spec.title: Hosts

spec.expr: count((up{job=~"$job"} == 0) and on (instance) last_over_time(windows_os_hostname{job=~"$job", hostname=~"$hostname"}[1d])) or (0 * count(up{job=~"$job"}))

spec.description: Selected hosts whose last scrape failed. Hosts stay selectable for one day after they stop reporting.
spec.title: Hosts down

spec.expr: count((100 * (1 - avg by (instance) (clamp_max(rate(windows_cpu_time_total{job=~"$job", mode="idle"}[$__rate_interval]), 1))) > 90) and on (instance) windows_os_hostname{job=~"$job", hostname=~"$hostname"}) or (0 * count(windows_os_hostname{job=~"$job", hostname=~"$hostname"}))

spec.description: Hosts whose CPU usage is above the cpuHighUsageThreshold of the WindowsCPUHighUsage alert. The alert also requires 15 minutes above it.
spec.title: CPU > 90%

spec.expr: count((max by (instance) (100 * (1 - windows_memory_physical_free_bytes{job=~"$job"} / windows_memory_physical_total_bytes{job=~"$job"})) > 90) and on (instance) windows_os_hostname{job=~"$job", hostname=~"$hostname"}) or (0 * count(windows_os_hostname{job=~"$job", hostname=~"$hostname"}))

spec.description: Hosts whose physical memory usage is above the memoryHighUsageThreshold of the WindowsMemoryHighUsage alert. The alert also requires 15 minutes above it.
spec.title: RAM > 90%

spec.expr: count((min by (instance) (100 * windows_logical_disk_free_bytes{job=~"$job", volume!~"HarddiskVolume.*"} / windows_logical_disk_size_bytes{job=~"$job", volume!~"HarddiskVolume.*"}) < 10) and on (instance) windows_os_hostname{job=~"$job", hostname=~"$hostname"}) or (0 * count(windows_os_hostname{job=~"$job", hostname=~"$hostname"}))

spec.description: Hosts with at least one volume with less than 10% free space, the diskFreeWarningThreshold of the WindowsDiskAlmostFull alert. HarddiskVolume* volumes without a drive letter are ignored.
spec.title: Low disk

spec.expr: count((count by (instance) (windows_service_state{job=~"$job", state="running"} == 0 and on (instance, service) windows_service_start_mode{job=~"$job", start_mode="auto"} == 1)) and on (instance) windows_os_hostname{job=~"$job", hostname=~"$hostname"}) or (0 * count(windows_os_hostname{job=~"$job", hostname=~"$hostname"}))

spec.description: Hosts with at least one service with start mode auto that is not running. Delayed-start and trigger-start services can show up here until they start.
spec.title: Auto stopped

spec.expr: topk(25, (100 * (1 - avg by (instance) (clamp_max(rate(windows_cpu_time_total{job=~"$job", mode="idle"}[$__rate_interval]), 1)))) * on (instance) group_left (hostname) max by (instance, hostname) (windows_os_hostname{job=~"$job", hostname=~"$hostname"}))

spec.description: Shows the 25 highest hosts at each point in time.
spec.title: CPU utilization

spec.expr: topk(25, (max by (instance) (100 * (1 - windows_memory_physical_free_bytes{job=~"$job"} / windows_memory_physical_total_bytes{job=~"$job"}))) * on (instance) group_left (hostname) max by (instance, hostname) (windows_os_hostname{job=~"$job", hostname=~"$hostname"}))

spec.description: Shows the 25 highest hosts at each point in time.
spec.title: Memory utilization

spec.expr: topk(25, (max by (instance) (100 * (1 - windows_logical_disk_free_bytes{job=~"$job", volume!~"HarddiskVolume.*"} / windows_logical_disk_size_bytes{job=~"$job", volume!~"HarddiskVolume.*"}))) * on (instance) group_left (hostname) max by (instance, hostname) (windows_os_hostname{job=~"$job", hostname=~"$hostname"}))

spec.description: Usage of the fullest volume per host. Shows the 25 highest hosts at each point in time.
spec.title: Fullest volume

spec.expr: topk(25, (sum by (instance) (rate(windows_net_bytes_sent_total{job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval]) * 8)) * on (instance) group_left (hostname) max by (instance, hostname) (windows_os_hostname{job=~"$job", hostname=~"$hostname"}))

topk(25, (sum by (instance) (rate(windows_net_bytes_received_total{job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval]) * 8)) * on (instance) group_left (hostname) max by (instance, hostname) (windows_os_hostname{job=~"$job", hostname=~"$hostname"}))

spec.description: Sum over all interfaces. Received is drawn below the axis. Shows the 25 highest hosts at each point in time.
spec.title: Network throughput

spec.expr: topk(25, (sum by (instance) (rate(windows_logical_disk_write_bytes_total{job=~"$job", volume!~"HarddiskVolume.*"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (instance) group_left (hostname) max by (instance, hostname) (windows_os_hostname{job=~"$job", hostname=~"$hostname"}))

topk(25, (sum by (instance) (rate(windows_logical_disk_read_bytes_total{job=~"$job", volume!~"HarddiskVolume.*"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (instance) group_left (hostname) max by (instance, hostname) (windows_os_hostname{job=~"$job", hostname=~"$hostname"}))

spec.description: Sum over all volumes. Read is drawn below the axis. Shows the 25 highest hosts at each point in time.
spec.title: Disk throughput

spec.expr: topk(25, (sum by (instance) (rate(windows_net_packets_received_errors_total{job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(windows_net_packets_received_discarded_total{job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(windows_net_packets_outbound_errors_total{job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(windows_net_packets_outbound_discarded_total{job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (instance) group_left (hostname) max by (instance, hostname) (windows_os_hostname{job=~"$job", hostname=~"$hostname"}))

spec.description: Sum over all interfaces of received and outbound errors and discards. Shows the 25 highest hosts at each point in time.
spec.title: Network errors and discards

spec.expr: topk(25, max by (instance) (rate(windows_net_bytes_total{job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval]) / (windows_net_current_bandwidth_bytes{job=~"$job"} > 0)) * on (instance) group_left (hostname) max by (instance, hostname) (windows_os_hostname{job=~"$job", hostname=~"$hostname"}))

spec.description: Utilization of the busiest interface of each host: bytes sent and received per second against its current bandwidth. Unlike the throughput sum, it shows a single saturated interface on a host with several. Shows the 25 highest hosts at each point in time.
spec.title: Busiest interface
Windows Exporter / Fleet
